title: HollyShorts London 2024
deck: Big Ben, in pencil, for the festival's first London edition.
lede: When HollyShorts first came to London, its identity started as pencil drawings of the clock tower. On the poster a film strip winds round it; on the badges, small drawn figures mark each pass.
challenge: The inaugural HollyShorts London took place at Curzon Soho in December 2024. It needed a new visual identity for the festival's international expansion: grounded in the parent brand, with UK cinematic culture and tone.
work: The city-specific system began on paper, with pencil drawings of the clock tower and the Westminster skyline on plain and grid paper. The drawings were shot under a camera on a tripod, so the pencil line could carry into the motion graphics as well as the print.

On the poster, a film strip winds round Big Ben. The line drawing carries into the badges, where each pass type has its own small drawn figure or object, a director's chair for filmmakers among them, and into tees, hoodies and the step-and-repeat. The festival announced itself on the Curzon Soho marquee.
system: Big Ben in pencil, with a film strip.
credits: Dalton Corr: creative direction, illustration, design
